bio.text: Chuck Gray has been Wyoming Secretary of State since January 2, 2023; Ballotpedia lists him as the Republican candidate for Wyoming's U.S. House seat in 2026, having won the August 18 Republican primary.
He served in the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 57, from 2017 to 2023.
According to Ballotpedia, he earned bachelor's degrees from the University of Pennsylvania in 2012 and worked as a radio executive and radio show host.
In his WyoFile election guide response, Gray says he took over his family's radio business in Casper after college.
